checkNote: The README gives no key requirement: the plugin only stages files on Zotero's local server, and the Chrome extension uploads to Gemini Notebook, which needs a Google sign-in the pack doesn't describe. The plugin has no AI features of its own (the optional MCP is for the user's own AI client), so local model is no; the quoted line is weak support but the pack shows no AI call.
